decisions.title: Canonical Native Executable Topology
decisions.decision_summary: Ship one canonical qiongli executable per target with typed internal modes and shared service crates.

decisions.title: Rust-Native UI And Accessibility Foundation
decisions.decision_summary: Use egui and native eframe with AccessKit, gated by target-native accessibility and packaging acceptance.

decisions.title: Agent Backend And Native Tool Host Boundary
decisions.decision_summary: Keep model backends capability-typed and separate from policy-enforced native tool execution.

decisions.title: Versioned State And Secret Storage
decisions.decision_summary: Use versioned atomic state, copy-on-migrate snapshots, secret references, and an OS-keychain-first facade.

decisions.title: Deterministic Embedded Resource Pack
decisions.decision_summary: Compile canonical content into a reproducible indexed pack with verified hashes and signed external updates.

decisions.title: Declarative Install Plan and Client Trust Boundaries
decisions.decision_summary: Use previewable transactional install plans and supported client source boundaries without bypassing host trust.

decisions.title: Release Channels and Native Artifact Identity
decisions.decision_summary: Give every signed target artifact and update channel a complete immutable native identity.
